neural.title: Neural Intent (Research)
neural.subtitle: Calibrated EEG selection through a least-privileged local sidecar
neural.research_only: Accessibility and research interface — not a medical device
neural.boundary: Heliox classifies a small, deliberately elicited vocabulary. It does not read unrestricted thoughts. Neural input cannot approve destructive actions or control physical equipment.
neural.photosensitivity: I understand that SSVEP interfaces use flickering targets, may cause discomfort, and may be unsafe for photosensitive users. Synthetic mode does not use my camera or biological EEG.
neural.no_hardware_body: Exercise BrainFlow locally or benchmark CSP/LDA on public PhysioNet EEGBCI recordings.
neural.physical_disabled: Physical control and neural approval remain disabled
neural.no_goals: Connect to the current daemon to load the compiled goal registry.
neural.task_launcher_body: Stage a goal with text first. Neural focus/select can launch it; Heliox then decomposes, routes specialists, executes, and verifies through the normal autonomous safety pipeline.
neural.no_staged_tasks: No autonomous task is staged. Heliox cannot infer an unstated task from EEG.
neural.task_preview_body: This goal was authored with text before neural selection. The selection launches the autonomous pipeline but does not approve later side effects; normal permissions, confirmations, agent limits, and verification still apply.
neural.task_result_body: Submitted means the autonomous job has started. Follow its visible activity and terminal result; it is not reported as completed until verification finishes.
neural.record_consent: Record raw EEG locally in encrypted form for the stated purpose. Nothing is uploaded, and secure OS key storage is required.
neural.export_consent: Also permit a later local BIDS/BrainVision export from this recording.
neural.preview_body: Inspect the resolved canonical goal. Press Escape or Cancel to disarm immediately.
neural.auto_commit: If no warning appears, the allow-listed Tier 0/1 action commits after the cancellation interval.

chat.empty_subtitle: Your AI system control agent. Type, speak, or gesture — I'm ready.

confirm.title: Confirmation Required
confirm.body: The following actions require your approval before execution. Uncheck any you don't want to run — the rest will be skipped.
confirm.nothing_checked: Nothing is checked. Check the actions you want to approve, or deny.

gesture.approve_not_visible: Open the Command tab to approve. Gestures can approve only a dialog you have had time to see.
gesture.approve_rearm: Lower your hand out of view, then raise it to approve by gesture.

interrupt.title: Heliox paused
interrupt.body: This was flagged as risky before running. Continue or stop?

rollback.title: Undo Last Action?
rollback.body: This will revert your entire disk state to the snapshot taken just before the last action ran — including any other changes made since then, not just what the action did. This cannot be undone.
rollback.banner: A snapshot was taken before the last action.

undo.title: Undo this task?
undo.intro: Heliox puts back what this task changed, newest first. Anything you changed since is left as it is.
undo.nothing_ready: Nothing from this task can be undone now.
undo.banner: Heliox can undo {count, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}} from this task.
undo.remaining: {count, plural, one {# more task comes} other {# more tasks come}} after this one; Cancel stops them all.
undo.show_changes: Show what changed in each file
undo.no_file_changes: No file contents changed in this task.

task_footer.undo: Undo {count, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}}

settings.title: Settings
settings.light_mode_desc: Switch between dark and light themes
settings.root_access_desc: Allow actions that require superuser privileges
settings.auto_snapshot_desc: Create system snapshot before destructive actions
settings.dry_run_desc: Plan and log actions without changing the OS, files, or processes
settings.camera_intelligence_desc: Controls the on-device hand-depth and gaze models that share the camera. New installs use real 3D hand landmarks by default; camera frames never leave this device.
settings.enhanced_3d_hand_tracking_desc: Uses MediaPipe Tasks world landmarks and 3D joint angles for reliable finger detection across rotated, tilted, and depth-facing hands
settings.enhanced_3d_status_on: Enabled · the live camera reports when metric 3D landmarks are actually present
settings.enhanced_3d_status_forced: Active for this session because gaze tracking requires the shared Tasks-Vision runtime
settings.enhanced_3d_status_off: Compatibility mode · normalized 2D landmarks and legacy gesture rules
settings.gaze_tracking_desc: Adds a coarse on-device screen-region gaze signal (left/right/up/down/center) as a third fusion input alongside voice and gesture. Only a region label and confidence ever leave the device — never camera frames or face landmarks. Off by default.
settings.gaze_tracking_enabled_desc: Loads MediaPipe's FaceLandmarker to estimate a coarse gaze region
settings.gaze_status_off_desc: No camera or face model is running.
settings.gaze_status_ready_desc: Open Command, then click the visible Gaze ready control to grant camera access and start tracking.
settings.gaze_status_scanning: Gaze on, looking for your face
settings.preview_desc: Before an autonomous background task commits to an action, pause and show a real screenshot with the target UI element highlighted (plus, for browser actions, a real measured before/after DOM diff), and wait for you to confirm or stop. Adds latency to every gated action, so it's off by default. Never a generated image — always a real screenshot and a real measured effect.
settings.preview_enabled_desc: Only applies to autonomous/unattended tasks — interactive voice, text, and gesture commands are unaffected
settings.undo_desc: Before Heliox writes, moves, copies or deletes a file, or replaces the clipboard, it keeps what it needs to put the change back. After a task you can review and undo it. Copies stay on this computer.
settings.undo_enabled_desc: Copies are deleted after {days} days. Messages, web actions and commands can never be undone.
settings.undo_on_toast: Undo history is on. New tasks can be undone.
settings.undo_off_toast: Undo history is off. New tasks cannot be undone.
settings.undo_clear_desc: Deletes every saved copy. Finished tasks can no longer be undone.
settings.gesture_cursor_warning: This drives your actual OS mouse cursor from webcam hand tracking. Off by default — an open palm or the engine's stop button always exits cursor mode immediately.
settings.gesture_cursor_enabled_desc: Move and click the real cursor by pointing and pinching
settings.gesture_cursor_sensitivity_desc: Scales how far the cursor moves per unit of hand motion
settings.gesture_cursor_blend_desc: How much predicted (vs. current) hand position feeds the cursor — 0 is current-only, 1 is fully predicted
settings.gesture_calibration_desc: Learns your pinch distance and thumb-extension style over time from normal usage — no new model, just a bounded on-device adjustment stored only in this browser.
settings.gesture_calibration_enabled_desc: Personalize pinch/thumb thresholds from implicit usage signals
settings.voice_calibration_desc: Learns accent/microphone-specific wake-word variants from repeated near-miss transcripts — stored only in a local file on this device, no audio is ever saved.
settings.voice_calibration_enabled_desc: Recognize confirmed wake-word variants alongside the default phrase
settings.voice_speech_desc: Kokoro and Pocket TTS are free, open-source local voice models — no API key or cloud synthesis. Kokoro provides the more natural default voice. Both fall back automatically to your OS voice if unavailable.
settings.tts_engine_desc: Kokoro for more natural local speech, Pocket TTS, or your OS's built-in voice
settings.tts_voice_desc: Built-in local model voice preset (ignored when using the OS voice)
settings.gesture_workflows_desc: Bind a gesture to a multi-step goal of your own choosing — the gesture starts that goal instead of its usual action. Off by default since this grants a gesture a new capability.
settings.gesture_workflows_goal_placeholder: e.g. back up today's screenshots and summarize the day
settings.gesture_workflows_live_desc: Saved changes apply immediately, including while the camera is already running.
settings.gesture_workflows_goal_required: Every binding needs a workflow goal.
settings.gesture_workflows_duplicate: Each gesture can only be bound once.
settings.gesture_workflows_enabled_required: Enable at least one complete binding before turning this feature on.
settings.gesture_workflows_no_gestures: Every supported gesture is already bound.
settings.voice_gesture_workflows_desc: Start a durable multi-step workflow here, or say “start workflow…” through the always-on voice listener. Explicitly bound gestures can start one too.
settings.self_healing_desc: Watches CPU/memory/disk and plans a fix when one crosses its threshold. Low-risk, reversible fixes run automatically; anything riskier is proposed below for you to approve or deny. Off by default.
settings.self_healing_tier_desc: Plans at or below this tier run without asking; anything higher (or irreversible) is always proposed for approval
settings.narration_desc: An independent companion reviews every proposed plan, can revise or stop misaligned work before it runs, and accepts live corrections throughout planning, execution, and verification. Optional spoken narration describes each step.
settings.narration_narrate_steps_desc: Speak a short description as each action starts and completes
settings.narration_interrupt_on_risk_desc: Pause and ask before running a plan or action flagged as risky
settings.narration_proactive_review_desc: Independently review every plan and automatically warn, revise, or stop it when it drifts from your request
settings.narration_live_corrections_desc: During planning, execution, or verification, send another message to interrupt the current phase and revise the task
settings.narration_follow_up_desc: After a verified task, suggest grounded next steps and keep them as context for your reply
settings.narration_timeout_desc: How long to wait for a response before treating an interrupt as denied
settings.narration_advisory_timeout_desc: Fail open after this delay so an unavailable model cannot stall execution
settings.adaptive_learning_desc: {patterns} learned patterns from {shown} suggestions: {accepted} accepted, {dismissed} dismissed. Preferences stay on this device.
settings.supervision_warning: Watches your own independent screen activity (window title + an occasional OCR text snippet) to offer cognitive coaching and warn about risky-looking content. Off by default. This is separate from, and does not affect, Heliox's own execution narration.
settings.supervision_cognitive_coaching_desc: Feeds a real screen snippet + window title to the cognitive engine and offers a gentle check-in on sustained stress/overload
settings.supervision_risk_detection_desc: Matches the OCR snippet against a small, explicit table of destructive-action patterns (e.g. rm -rf, DROP TABLE)
settings.supervision_hook_warning: This installs a system-wide keyboard and mouse hook that observes your typing and clicks outside Heliox, to check for the same risky patterns. Off by default. Nothing you type or click is ever saved to disk or sent anywhere — only the fact that a risk pattern matched. Turning this off instantly removes the hook.
settings.supervision_hook_understood: I understand this reads my keystrokes and clicks system-wide to check for risk patterns, and nothing else
settings.supervision_hook_enabled_desc: Installs a global input hook for stronger risk detection
settings.supervision_hook_unhealthy: Hook appears to have stopped — risk detection from typing/clicks is not currently active.
settings.ollama_model_desc: Model tag to use with Ollama
settings.reset_desc: Clear local settings and restore default configuration
settings.reset_confirm: Are you sure you want to reset all settings to defaults?

human_control.you_have_control: You have the desktop. Heliox paused its own clicks and typing.
human_control.agent_working: Heliox is working on its own.
